# “Den största noteringen någonsin”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-19  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This EFN Morgon episode centres on what the hosts call possibly the biggest IPO ever, Anthropic, priced at $83, above the $70-78 range, for a valuation of about $1.5 trillion. They suggest money may be pulled out of other positions to fund it. The rest is a news roundup. The AI trade is being questioned while cybersecurity stocks rallied. Take-Two jumped on the GTA 6 release. Revolution Race and NKT reported results. Copper, metals and gold prices are weak, and the Fed minutes signalled more rate hikes. On the Swedish side, ABG says buy Truecaller, EFN says buy FM Mattsson, and Yubico and NCAB hold capital markets days.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 TRUE-B — Truecaller | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

ABG gave it a buy recommendation, cited briefly in the news roundup.

#### Reasoning

A cited analyst view (ABG), not the hosts' own opinion. No reasoning or price target was given in the episode, so conviction is moderate.

#### Sell Triggers

- if ABG downgrades the recommendation
- if growth or margins disappoint in the next report

> *"Truecaller har fått en köprekommendation av ABG."*

---

### 🟢 FMM-B — FM Mattsson | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

EFN has set a buy recommendation, with details on efn.se.

#### Reasoning

An in-house EFN recommendation mentioned in passing. No reasoning was discussed on air, so conviction is moderate.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EFN withdraws the recommendation
- if the construction and renovation market weakens further

> *"EFN har satt köp på FM Mattsson, vilket går att läsa mer om på efn.se."*

---

### 🟠 RVRC — Revolution Race | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Q1 sales up and the Nordics +26%, but Germany, about half of sales, grew only 2%. Germany sank the stock 11% last time.

#### Reasoning

The hosts read the headlines live and gave no verdict. Strong Nordic growth is offset by stagnating Germany, the largest market and the one that drove the last selloff. Market reaction to the report is the near-term catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Germany sales turn negative
- if the market punishes the report as it did last time

> *"Men det verkar som att Tysklands regionen fortsatt inte direkt är det som drar upp. Den växer med 2 %."*
